name: UFO
description: Microsoft's desktop agent system that automates Windows applications and orchestrates tasks across Windows, Linux and Android devices.
whatItDoes: UFO turns natural-language requests into actions inside desktop applications, and in its newer Galaxy mode splits a request into sub-tasks dispatched to several registered devices. It targets users and researchers automating multi-step GUI work.
howItWorks: The UFO2 desktop agent combines UI Automation and vision to control Windows apps through a host agent and per-app agents. Galaxy adds a ConstellationAgent that decomposes a request into a task DAG, assigns tasks to device agents and runs them asynchronously. LLM settings live in YAML config files.

requirements.name: Windows
requirements.description: Desktop agent targets Windows; Galaxy also drives Linux and Android devices

models: OpenAI, Azure OpenAI and other configurable providers
